name: Words
title: Words — Free Letter Wheel Word Game | DoPop
summary: Connect letters around a wheel to uncover words. Words offers 1,000 fixed letter sets with saved progress, a puzzle selector and bonus words.
steps: Drag through the letters in order to spell a word. You can use each letter tile only once in a word.
Release to submit. Correct target words fill the empty circles; other accepted words may count as bonus words.
Use Shuffle to see the same letters in a new order, or spend points on a hint when you need help.
tip: Start with short combinations, then look for longer words using the same letters. A shuffled wheel changes the arrangement, not the puzzle.
controls: Drag or swipe through the letter wheel. The check button submits the current selection.
progress: 1,000 levels. Your level and points stay in this browser.

name: Sudoku
title: Sudoku — Free Online Number Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Fill a nine-by-nine Sudoku grid at your own pace. DoPop includes difficulty selection, notes and number controls in a clean layout that works on phones and computers.
steps: Fill empty cells with the numbers 1 through 9.
Each row, column and outlined three-by-three box must contain each number exactly once.
Select a cell and use the number controls. Use notes to keep track of candidates.
tip: Look for a row, column or box with only a few missing numbers. A number already present in a unit cannot appear there again.
controls: Tap a cell, then a number. Use the difficulty and level controls to choose a puzzle.
progress: Choose puzzles and difficulty using the game controls. Progress is local to this browser.

name: Snake
title: Snake — Free Browser Arcade Game | DoPop
summary: Guide a chain of dots toward food without hitting your own tail. DoPop’s Snake has touch controls, speed choices, four color palettes and round or square pieces.
steps: Choose a starting speed, then swipe or press an arrow to start.
Steer toward food to grow your snake. Avoid turning into your own body.
The field wraps at its edges. Keep space available for your growing tail.
tip: Wide turns leave more room than tight circles. A slower starting speed gives you time to plan a route.
controls: Swipe or drag to steer. Arrow keys and supported direction controls also change direction.
progress: An endless arcade round with speed and appearance preferences. A running round is not a cloud save.

name: Falling Blocks
title: Falling Blocks — Free Block Puzzle Game | DoPop
summary: Move and rotate falling pieces to complete horizontal rows. Falling Blocks offers a next-piece preview, starting levels and a dotted DoPop play field.
steps: Move each falling piece left or right to choose where it will land.
Rotate pieces to fill gaps, then drop them when the position is right.
Complete horizontal rows to clear space. The round ends when new pieces cannot enter the field.
tip: Build a level surface and avoid covering deep gaps. Check the next-piece preview before committing to a placement.
controls: Use the on-screen move, rotate and drop buttons, touch controls or supported keyboard controls.
progress: Choose a starting level and appearance. Arcade progress follows the current round.

name: Word Search
title: Word Search — Free Online Word Finder | DoPop
summary: Find the listed words hidden in a letter grid. DoPop’s Word Search uses eight themed word selections, deterministic puzzles and a puzzle selector.
steps: Read the word list beside the letter grid.
Drag across a straight line of letters to select a hidden word.
Find every listed word to finish the puzzle and move on.
tip: Scan for a word’s first and last letters, then check whether the letters between them form a straight line.
controls: Drag or swipe across letters. Use Level to choose a puzzle.
progress: Your puzzle number stays in this browser. Found words in an unfinished grid are not persisted.

name: Number Path
title: Number Path — Free Number Connection Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Trace a continuous route through numbered checkpoints in order and cover the whole board. Number Path has 1,000 generated levels with walls, editable paths and saved attempts.
steps: Start at the first numbered checkpoint.
Draw through adjacent cells, visiting the numbered checkpoints in order without crossing your path or passing through walls.
Cover every available cell and reach the final checkpoint to complete the level.
tip: Check narrow passages before drawing a long route. Passing through a bottleneck too early can leave an unreachable area.
controls: Drag continuously across cells. Use the path editing and level controls to revise or switch puzzles.
progress: 1,000 levels with a locally saved route and level selector.

name: Fidget
title: Fidget — Free Online Spinners and Gears | DoPop
summary: Take a quiet break with tactile spinners and connected gears. Fidget is free play with several shapes, color choices and motion effects, rather than a scored puzzle.
steps: Choose a spinner shape or the Connected gears mode.
Drag or flick the object to put it in motion.
Try a different shape or color whenever you want a change.
tip: A short flick and a longer drag feel different. There is no target score or required sequence to complete.
controls: Drag or flick on the play field. Use the mode and color buttons below it.
progress: Free play with appearance controls. No levels, account or leaderboard are required.

name: Maze Chase
title: Maze Chase — Free Dot Collection Arcade Game | DoPop
summary: Guide an ant through a dotted maze, collect the dots and avoid spiders. Maze Chase changes layouts across 1,000 levels and supports queued turns, appearance choices and saved progress.
steps: Swipe or press an arrow to start steering the ant through open passages.
Collect dots while avoiding the spiders. Ring beacons provide a temporary powered state.
Clear the maze to move to the next layout. Keep track of your remaining lives.
tip: Queue a turn before reaching a junction. Use a beacon when spiders are close, rather than collecting every beacon immediately.
controls: Swipe, drag, or use arrow keys. Pause stops the round; your next direction resumes it.
progress: 1,000 maze layouts with local progress. After dialogs or backgrounding, a fresh direction resumes the round.

name: Dot Connect
title: Dot Connect — Free Color Matching Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Join matching dots to meet collection goals within a move budget. Dot Connect has 100 levels with color-and-symbol clues, loop clears and frost in later levels.
steps: Drag through at least two matching dots that touch horizontally or vertically.
Trace backward to shorten a chain. Closing a loop of at least four dots clears that color across the board.
Meet the collection goals before your moves run out. Clear frost by removing its dot.
tip: A loop can be more useful than a longer open chain. Check the remaining goals before spending a move on a color you no longer need.
controls: Drag through dots. With a keyboard, focus a dot, use Space to extend a chain and Enter to clear it.
progress: 100 levels, saved progress, undo and a level selector.

title: 2048 — Free Online Number Merging Game | DoPop
summary: Slide numbered tiles on a four-by-four board and merge equal neighbors. DoPop’s 2048 includes undo, saved boards, a best score and the option to keep playing after reaching 2048.
steps: Swipe or choose a direction to slide all tiles.
Equal tiles merge once per move, and an effective move adds a new tile.
Reach 2048 or keep building a higher score. A round ends when there are no legal moves.
tip: Keep your largest tiles organized and leave open cells available. Repeatedly changing your preferred direction can scatter the board.
controls: Swipe, use arrow keys or WASD, or choose the on-screen arrows.
progress: An endless number puzzle with a saved board, best score and one-step undo.

name: Color Paths
title: Color Paths — Free Pair Connection Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Connect matching numbered endpoints while filling every cell. Color Paths offers 50 levels in which paths must stay on the grid and cannot cross.
steps: Start at a numbered endpoint and draw toward its matching partner.
Use adjacent cells without crossing another path.
Connect every pair and cover the entire board to finish.
tip: Connect pairs with constrained routes first. Leave enough room for the pairs whose endpoints are farther apart.
controls: Drag from an endpoint. Keyboard players can focus an endpoint, press Space, use arrows to draw and Enter to finish.
progress: 50 levels with local attempts, undo and confirmed reset.

name: Untangle
title: Untangle — Free Crossing Lines Logic Game | DoPop
summary: Move connected dots until the lines stop crossing. Untangle has 50 generated levels, keyboard movement, undo and appearance options.
steps: Look for highlighted lines that cross another connection.
Move the dots to separate those connections while keeping the graph intact.
Remove every crossing without overlapping dots or placing a dot on another line.
tip: Spread the dots out first, then resolve small groups of crossings. A dot near the edge can make space for several connections at once.
controls: Drag a dot or focus it and use arrow keys. Undo reverses the last committed move.
progress: 50 levels with saved attempts and appearance preferences.

name: Flood
title: Flood — Free Color Filling Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Expand the color region in the top-left corner until it fills the board. Flood includes 50 levels, a move budget and matching symbols for the colors.
steps: Start with the marked top-left region.
Choose a color to change that region and absorb adjacent cells of the selected color.
Fill the board before using the whole move budget.
tip: A color that gives little space now can open a larger region on the next move. Compare the edges of your region before choosing.
controls: Tap a color-and-symbol button below the board. Use Undo to revise the previous move.
progress: 50 levels with saved boards, move counts and undo.

name: Word Guess
title: Word Guess — Free Five-Letter Word Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Find a five-letter word in six guesses. Word Guess has a daily puzzle, 1,000 fixed levels, hard mode, clue symbols and locally stored statistics.
steps: Enter a five-letter word and submit it.
Green means the correct letter in the correct position, amber means the letter belongs elsewhere, and gray means it has no remaining match.
Use the feedback to find the answer within six guesses. Repeated letters are counted only as often as they appear in the answer.
tip: Compare every clue, including gray letters and repeated-letter counts. Hard mode requires you to reuse revealed clues after the first submitted guess.
controls: Use the on-screen keyboard or type with a physical keyboard. Settings can add clue symbols alongside color.
progress: A device-local daily schedule and 1,000 level answers. Saves, statistics and streaks stay in this browser; this is not another publisher’s daily schedule.

name: Light Up
title: Light Up — Free Light Placement Logic Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Illuminate an entire grid while keeping bulbs out of one another’s sight. Light Up includes 50 levels with numbered walls and saved attempts.
steps: Place bulbs in open cells to light their rows and columns until a wall blocks the light.
Do not let two bulbs see one another along an uninterrupted row or column.
Satisfy each numbered wall’s count of adjacent bulbs and illuminate every open cell.
tip: A zero clue forbids bulbs next to it. Use numbered walls to constrain placements before filling open areas.
controls: Tap an open cell to place or remove a bulb. Level, Undo and Reset are available below the board.
progress: 50 levels with local attempts, undo and appearance controls.

name: Bridges
title: Bridges — Free Island Connection Logic Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Connect numbered islands into one network with single or double bridges. DoPop’s Bridges has 50 levels and tap targets between neighboring islands.
steps: Connect neighboring islands horizontally or vertically.
Use zero, one or two bridges between a pair. The total at each island must match its number.
Connect every island into a single network without crossing bridges.
tip: An island with few neighbors limits where its bridges can go. Check that a small completed group still has a connection to the rest of the board.
controls: Tap the space between islands to cycle zero, one and two bridges.
progress: 50 levels with saved attempts, undo and appearance controls.

name: Slide
title: Slide — Free Sliding Number Tile Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Slide numbered tiles into order using the empty space. Slide offers 50 levels, beginning with three-by-three boards and expanding to four-by-four puzzles.
steps: Tap a numbered tile beside the empty space to slide it.
Arrange the numbers in ascending row order.
Finish with the empty space in the bottom-right corner.
tip: Place a row or column at a time, and preserve the section you have already organized. Use the blank space to rotate small groups of tiles.
controls: Tap a tile adjacent to the blank. Use Undo if a move disrupts a solved section.
progress: 50 boards generated through legal moves, with saved attempts and undo.

name: Binary Grid
title: Binary Grid — Free Two-Color Logic Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Complete a grid of two tile types using balance, adjacency and uniqueness rules. Binary Grid includes 50 levels with fixed clues and saved progress.
steps: Give every empty cell one of the two tile types.
Do not place three matching tiles consecutively in a row or column. Each completed row and column needs equal counts of both types.
Keep completed rows and columns distinct; no two may be identical.
tip: Two equal neighbors constrain the next cell. A nearly balanced row can also reveal which type belongs in its remaining spaces.
controls: Tap a cell to cycle blue, amber and empty. Fixed clues cannot be changed.
progress: 50 levels with saved attempts, undo and appearance choices.

name: Sightline
title: Sightline — Free Visibility Logic Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Mark cells open or blocked to satisfy numbered visibility clues. Sightline has 50 levels and counts what each clue can see along its row and column.
steps: Numbered cells are fixed open cells.
A clue counts itself and the open cells it sees in the four straight directions until a blocked cell stops the view.
Mark the other cells so every clue matches its visibility total.
tip: Count the open cells a clue must already see, then consider how a blocked cell would limit its remaining sight lines.
controls: Tap to cycle open, blocked and unknown. Use Undo to revisit a deduction.
progress: 50 levels with local attempts, undo and appearance controls.

name: Ants Apart
title: Ants Apart — Free Ant Separation Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Draw safe lines across a dotted field until each ant has its own space. Ants Apart combines moving ants with careful route choices across 36 levels.
steps: Start from the pale blue edge or a completed blue line.
Leave the safe line to drop a seed trail, then reach another safe line to complete the cut.

Keep cutting until every region contains at most one ant. Direct ant contact with the person costs one heart. An eaten unfinished line vanishes and returns the person to that line’s starting point without losing a heart; completed lines remain. Retry the level when hearts run out.
tip: Watch the ants before leaving a safe edge. A short cut through a clear area can be easier to finish than a long cut across the field.
controls: Use direction buttons, swipe or drag, or Arrow/WASD keys. A fresh direction starts or resumes play after a pause.
progress: 36 levels, best cut counts and saved boards including unfinished trails. An inline guide explains the opening level.

name: Rotate Network
title: Rotate Network — Free Tile Rotation Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Rotate path tiles to restore a single connected network. Rotate Network has 30 fixed, unique-solution levels on four-by-four and five-by-five boards.
steps: Tap a tile to rotate its paths.
Match neighboring connections without leaving loose ends at the edge.
Join every tile into one network without a closed loop. Lock a tile when you want to protect its orientation.
tip: Begin at the edges, where paths cannot point outside the board. Work inward from tiles with only one possible orientation.
controls: Tap to rotate. Use Lock tiles to toggle locks, or press L on a focused tile. Arrow keys move focus; Enter or Space activates it.
progress: 30 pinned levels with saved attempts, up to 30 undo steps and explicit Next level progression.

name: Loop
title: Loop — Free Single Loop Number Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Draw one closed loop around a grid of number clues. Loop includes 30 fixed, unique-solution puzzles on a five-by-five cell grid.
steps: Mark grid edges to form one continuous closed loop.
Each numbered cell tells you how many of its four edges belong to the loop.
Keep the loop unbranched and avoid separate closed loops. Blank clues impose no number constraint.
tip: A zero excludes all four surrounding edges. At each used corner, the loop must enter and leave rather than stop or branch.
controls: Tap an edge to cycle line, excluded and unknown. Arrow keys move focus; Enter or Space changes an edge.
progress: 30 pinned levels with saved attempts, undo and explicit Next level progression.

name: Color Code
title: Color Code — Free Color and Symbol Code Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Infer a hidden four-symbol code from exact and misplaced matches. Color Code includes 30 fixed codes, four color-and-shape choices and eight guesses per level.
steps: Choose four symbols and press Check. Symbols may repeat.
A filled feedback dot means a correct symbol in the correct position; an open dot means a correct symbol elsewhere.
Use those counts to find the code in eight guesses. Feedback does not identify particular slots, and each symbol is counted only once.
tip: Change a guess deliberately so that the new feedback tells you something. Repeated symbols can help test how many copies belong in the code.
controls: Choose a slot and a color-and-symbol button, or type 1–4. Use Check or the supported Enter shortcut to submit.
progress: 30 fixed codes with saved guesses, undo and explicit Next level progression.

name: Picture Grid
title: Picture Grid — Free Run Clue Picture Puzzle | DoPop
summary: Use row and column clues to reveal an original abstract pattern. Picture Grid has 30 fixed, unique-solution levels on five-by-five and seven-by-seven boards.
steps: Read the run-length clues beside a row and above a column.
Fill consecutive groups of the specified lengths in order, leaving at least one empty cell between groups.
Match every row and column clue to reveal the pattern. You can mark known empty cells with a cross.
tip: Compare the minimum space required by a clue with the row length. Long runs often overlap across their possible positions.
controls: Tap a cell to cycle filled, empty and unknown. Arrow keys move focus; Enter or Space changes a cell.
progress: 30 pinned levels with saved attempts, undo and explicit Next level progression.
